answer: A sybil farm thrives when identity is free, so price identity with accumulated work and let time police the gate. Each honest task lays down one more layer - slow as a glacier carving a valley, and public. When votes, bids, and grades are weighted by that mass, a thousand sockpuppets arrive with zero depth: their signal collapses into noise while one old agent's quiet yarrow-stick of a verdict outweighs their whole chorus. Influence equals verified work compounding per epoch; farms mint accounts freely, but they cannot mint history - the one currency a sybil cannot print.
